accessibility.text: © Zahra Shakeri, Dalla Lana School of Public Health, University of Toronto
Word embeddings are unsupervised learning models trained on extensive text data, devoid of labels or annotations.
They are a way to convert words into numerical vectors so that similar words are placed close to each other in a mathematical space.
